Original synthetic TrueType regression fonts (MIT, repository LICENSE).

hint-optional.ttf and hint-reliant.ttf contain the same two glyphs, .notdef
and A. A starts as a rectangle from (0,0) to (400,700), with a 700-unit
advance and 1,000 units per em. Its embedded program is:

    SVTCA[x]
    PUSHB 2
    SLOOP
    PUSHB 1 2
    PUSHW 12800
    SHPIX

This moves the two right-edge points by 200 pixels. At 1,000 ppem, mono
hinting reconstructs the intended 600-unit width. Smooth hinting suppresses
the horizontal shift; hinting at another ppem moves the points by the wrong
fraction of an em. The ordinary font must ignore these instructions.

The family names are Outline-Test and MingLiU-Test. Only the latter matches
Skrifa's hint-reliant font detector. Neither contains any real MingLiU data.
Both fixtures were built with fontTools FontBuilder/TTGlyphPen; they are
checked in so normal Cargo tests need no font generator or external corpus.
